svg.text: HARDWARE LIBRARY - CATALOGUE, IMPORT AND SYMBOLS

g.text: 1. US-001 Adding hardware that is not in the catalogue
Create a type with manufacturer, model and port layout. It becomes placeable at once.
Import applies what it can read and reports what it skipped, and why.
3. US-003 Using an organisation's own symbols
Import a symbol set and assign symbols, so plans follow the house style.
4. US-004 Browsing and organising the catalogue
Search and filter by category and plane. Your own types stay distinguishable.
A layout beyond the limit is rejected, and the limit is stated.
Your version is kept when a release changes it. Restore returns the shipped one.
Deletion is blocked while a type is placed
The application names the plans still using it, rather than removing it.
Catalogue held in a local database
Searchable without loading it all. An interrupted write cannot damage it.
